organization.name: Datadog, Inc.
organization.notes: Independent public company; Nasdaq DDOG since 2019. Company founded in New York in 2010; Infrastructure product launched later. SEC ownership disclosure verifies historical Index Ventures and ICONIQ equity interests; no claim these remain unchanged today.

pricingTiers.name: Infrastructure Pro
pricingTiers.notes: Advertised $15 per host/month billed annually, multiplied by 12. $18 is explicitly on-demand; not assumed to be a monthly subscription. Free plan separately covers up to five hosts.
No public designation or verified amount found in reviewed pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Infrastructure Pro
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational entry plan; no named Business tier in Infrastructure. Annual $15 x12; other Datadog products charged separately.

pricingTiers.name: Infrastructure Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Advertised annual-billed $23 per host/month x12. $27 on-demand is separate; excess metrics/containers and other products can add charges.

moats.claim: The integration catalog and accumulated monitoring configurations can create workflow switching costs; this does not establish exclusive technical superiority.

productReasons.claim: Broad integrations and shared dashboards let operators investigate infrastructure alongside application signals.
Outlier, anomaly and forecast monitors help surface abnormal behavior beyond fixed thresholds.
Host/container maps and Live Processes support investigation of changing infrastructure.
